actions.reason: Neither change met the 1% minimum. Merging from the rarer token in merge() made train_ir 4.6% worse (ratio 1.0458). Bounded tie-breaking in BasicTokenizer.train improved it by only 0.29% (ratio 0.9971). Both kept outputs identical. Without profiling it is unclear where the ~607M train instructions go; startup and import costs probably dominate the library hot paths, which earlier generations have already optimized. I'm not submitting an unaccepted change.
